# Data Preparation
- Note: This data does not contain and protein identifications from contaminants
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, paged.print=FALSE}
# Clear R's Brain
rm(list = ls())

# Set the working directory
setwd("/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Supplementary/MockD6300/")

# Load the libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Mock-community assembly and polishing analysis
#
# GOAL
# Compare assembly contiguity, rRNA-gene recovery, assembly
# quality and nucleotide accuracy across sequencing,
# assembly and polishing strategies.
#
# INPUT
# `dat`: First sheet of Workflow_Comparison.xlsx, loaded in
# the preceding data-loading block.
#
# SELECTION
# - Eight bacterial mock-community members
# - Eukaryotic organisms are excluded
# - Uncorrected assemblies are used for the comparisons
#   between Reference, metaSpades, megahit, canu and metaFlye
# - Six explicitly selected metaFlye workflows are used for
#   the polishing comparison
#
# OUTPUT
# Plot objects:
# - Assembly_Contiguity_Comparison
# - rRNA_Gene_Recovery
# - Assembly_Quality_Comparison
# - Polishing_Accuracy_Comparison
#
# PNG files:
# - Fig_A4_Page/Assembly_Contiguity_Comparison.png
# - Fig_A4_Page/rRNA_Gene_Recovery.png
# - Fig_A4_Page/Assembly_Quality_Comparison.png
# - Fig_A4_Page/Polishing_Accuracy_Comparison.png
############################################################


############################################################
# Shared analysis and plotting settings
############################################################

# Define the order of organisms
organism_levels <- c(
  "Bacillus",
  "Enterococcus",
  "Escherichia",
  "Lactobacillus",
  "Listeria",
  "Pseudomonas",
  "Salmonella",
  "Staphylococcus"
)

# Define the order of assembly workflows
assembler_levels <- c(
  "Reference",
  "metaSpades",
  "megahit",
  "canu",
  "metaFlye"
)

# Define the sequencing-technology order
technology_levels <- c(
  "Reference",
  "Illumina",
  "Nanopore"
)

# Colours reproduced from the original figures
technology_colours <- c(
  Reference = "#FFFFFF",
  Illumina  = "#9ECAE1",
  Nanopore  = "#FF6347"
)

# Standardize the variables used throughout the analysis
workflow_data <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Organism = factor(
      trimws(as.character(ZymoBIOMICS.STD.refseq.v2)),
      levels = organism_levels
    ),

    Technology = factor(
      trimws(as.character(SequencingTechnology)),
      levels = technology_levels
    ),

    Assembler_key = tolower(
      gsub(
        "[^[:alnum:]]",
        "",
        trimws(as.character(Assembler))
      )
    ),

    Assembler_Plot = case_when(
      Technology == "Reference"     ~ "Reference",
      Assembler_key == "metaspades" ~ "metaSpades",
      Assembler_key == "megahit"    ~ "megahit",
      Assembler_key == "canu"       ~ "canu",
      Assembler_key == "metaflye"   ~ "metaFlye",
      TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Assembler_Plot = factor(
      Assembler_Plot,
      levels = assembler_levels
    ),

    Correction_Workflow = case_when(
      is.na(Correction) ~ "Uncorrected",

      trimws(as.character(Correction)) %in%
        c("", "NA", "Uncorrected") ~ "Uncorrected",

      TRUE ~ trimws(as.character(Correction))
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Organism))

# Select uncorrected assemblies for the general comparisons
uncorrected_assembly_data <- workflow_data %>%
  filter(
    Correction_Workflow == "Uncorrected",
    !is.na(Assembler_Plot)
  )

# Shared visual style
mock_comparison_theme <- theme_bw(
  base_size = 9,
  base_family = "sans"
) +
  theme(
    # Axis titles and labels
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 9,
      colour = "black",
      margin = margin(t = 5)
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 7,
      colour = "black",
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 7,
      colour = "black"
    ),

    axis.ticks = element_line(
      colour = "#666666",
      linewidth = 0.30
    ),

    axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(1.5, "pt"),

    # Show only horizontal gridlines positioned at
    # the labelled major y-axis breaks
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      colour = "#E5E5E5",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    # Panel borders and spacing
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = "#8C8C8C",
      linewidth = 0.50
    ),

    panel.spacing = grid::unit(2.5, "pt"),

    # Organism and metric labels
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#F0F0F0",
      colour = "#8C8C8C",
      linewidth = 0.50
    ),

    strip.text.x = element_text(
      size = 8,
      face = "bold",
      colour = "black",
      margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2)
    ),

    strip.text.y.left = element_text(
      size = 8,
      face = "bold",
      colour = "black",
      angle = 90,
      margin = margin(l = 2, r = 2)
    ),

    # Legend
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 8,
      colour = "black"
    ),

    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(10, "pt"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(8, "pt"),
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(3, "pt"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 1, l = 0),

    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 5, b = 2, l = 2)
  )


############################################################
# Assembly contiguity comparison
#
# Genome size, longest contig and number of contigs are
# compared across the reference, two Illumina assemblers
# and two Nanopore assemblers.
############################################################

# Data wrangling
assembly_contiguity_data <- uncorrected_assembly_data %>%
  select(
    Organism,
    Technology,
    Assembler_Plot,
    Genome_Size,
    Longest_Contig,
    Nr_Contigs
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Genome_Size,
      Longest_Contig,
      Nr_Contigs
    ),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      Metric,
      Genome_Size    = "Genome size (bp)",
      Longest_Contig = "Longest contig (bp)",
      Nr_Contigs     = "Number of contigs"
    ),

    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "Genome size (bp)",
        "Longest contig (bp)",
        "Number of contigs"
      )
    )
  )

# Figure plotting
Assembly_Contiguity_Comparison <- ggplot(
  assembly_contiguity_data,
  aes(
    x = Assembler_Plot,
    y = Value
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = 1),
    colour = "#BDBDBD",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Technology),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.1,
    stroke = 0.35,
    colour = "#7F7F7F"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = assembler_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      big.mark = " ",
      decimal.mark = "."
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.05, 0.08)
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = technology_colours,
    breaks = technology_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(Metric),
    cols = vars(Organism),
    scales = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        size = 2.2,
        stroke = 0.35,
        colour = "#7F7F7F"
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Assembler",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  mock_comparison_theme

# Show the figure
Assembly_Contiguity_Comparison

# Export the figure
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    
    "Assembly_Contiguity_Comparison.png"
  ),
  plot = Assembly_Contiguity_Comparison,
  device = "png",
  width = 15,
  height = 8.7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)


############################################################
# rRNA-gene recovery
#
# Recovery of 5S, 16S and 23S rRNA genes is compared across
# reference, Illumina and Nanopore assembly workflows.
############################################################

# Data wrangling
rrna_recovery_data <- uncorrected_assembly_data %>%

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      Metric,
      Nr_5S  = "Recovered 5S rRNA genes",
      Nr_16S = "Recovered 16S rRNA genes",
      Nr_23S = "Recovered 23S rRNA genes"
    ),

    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "Recovered 5S rRNA genes",
        "Recovered 16S rRNA genes",
        "Recovered 23S rRNA genes"

# Figure plotting
rRNA_Gene_Recovery <- ggplot(

# Show the figure
rRNA_Gene_Recovery

# Export the figure
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    
    "rRNA_Gene_Recovery.png"
  ),

############################################################
# Assembly quality comparison
#
# Completeness, contamination, reference similarity,
# reference-aligned coverage and mismatch rates are compared
# across the uncorrected assembly workflows.
############################################################

# Data wrangling
assembly_quality_data <- uncorrected_assembly_data %>%
  select(
    Organism,
    Technology,
    Assembler_Plot,
    checkM_completeness,
    checkM_contamination,
    average_nucleotide_identity_ani2,
    average_coverage_ani2,
    `Mismatches per 100kbp`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      checkM_completeness,
      checkM_contamination,
      average_nucleotide_identity_ani2,
      average_coverage_ani2,
      `Mismatches per 100kbp`
    ),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      Metric,

      checkM_completeness =
        "checkM completeness (%)",

      checkM_contamination =
        "checkM contamination (%)",

      average_nucleotide_identity_ani2 =
        "ANI to reference (%)",

      average_coverage_ani2 =
        "Reference-aligned coverage (%)",

      `Mismatches per 100kbp` =
        "Mismatches per 100 kbp"
    ),

    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "checkM completeness (%)",
        "checkM contamination (%)",
        "ANI to reference (%)",
        "Reference-aligned coverage (%)",
        "Mismatches per 100 kbp"
      )
    )
  )

# Figure plotting
Assembly_Quality_Comparison <- ggplot(
  assembly_quality_data,
  aes(
    x = Assembler_Plot,
    y = Value
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = 1),
    colour = "#BDBDBD",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Technology),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.1,
    stroke = 0.35,
    colour = "#7F7F7F"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = assembler_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      big.mark = " ",
      decimal.mark = "."
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.05, 0.08)
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = technology_colours,
    breaks = technology_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(Metric),
    cols = vars(Organism),
    scales = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        size = 2.2,

Assembly_Quality_Comparison

############################################################
# Polishing accuracy comparison
#
# ANI, mismatch rates and indel rates are compared across
# six explicitly selected metaFlye correction workflows.
# The uncorrected metaFlye assembly is used as the baseline.
############################################################

# Map the exact input names to concise display labels
correction_name_map <- c(
  "metaFlye" =
    "Uncorrected",

  "Metaflye_Racon" =
    "racon",

  "Metaflye_Racon_Medaka" =
    "racon_medaka",

  "Metaflye_Racon_Medaka_Pilon" =
    "racon_medaka_pilon",

  "Metaflye_Racon_Medaka_Pilon_Pilon" =
    "racon_medaka_pilon_pilon",

  "Metaflye_3Racon_2Medaka_3Pilon" =
    "racon3_medaka2_pilon3"
)

correction_levels <- unname(correction_name_map)

# Data wrangling
polishing_accuracy_data <- workflow_data %>%
  filter(
    Name %in% names(correction_name_map)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Correction_Workflow = correction_name_map[
      as.character(Name)
    ],

    Correction_Workflow = factor(
      Correction_Workflow,
      levels = correction_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Organism,
    Correction_Workflow,
    average_nucleotide_identity_ani2,
    `Mismatches per 100kbp`,
    `Indels per 100 kbp`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      average_nucleotide_identity_ani2,
      `Mismatches per 100kbp`,
      `Indels per 100 kbp`
    ),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      Metric,

      average_nucleotide_identity_ani2 =
        "ANI to reference (%)",

      `Mismatches per 100kbp` =
        "Mismatches per 100 kbp",

      `Indels per 100 kbp` =
        "Indels per 100 kbp"
    ),

    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "ANI to reference (%)",
        "Mismatches per 100 kbp",
        "Indels per 100 kbp"
      )
    )
  )

# Figure plotting
Polishing_Accuracy_Comparison <- ggplot(
  polishing_accuracy_data,
  aes(
    x = Correction_Workflow,
    y = Value
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = 1),
    colour = "#BDBDBD",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.1,
    stroke = 0.35,
    colour = "#7F7F7F",
    fill = technology_colours[["Nanopore"]]
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = correction_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      big.mark = " ",
      decimal.mark = "."
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.05, 0.08)
    )
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(Metric),
    cols = vars(Organism),
    scales = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Correction workflow",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  mock_comparison_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Show the figure
Polishing_Accuracy_Comparison

# Export the figure
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    
    "Polishing_Accuracy_Comparison.png"
  ),
  plot = Polishing_Accuracy_Comparison,
  device = "png",
  width = 15,
  height = 9,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Source data: Supplementary Figures 6-9
# Run after creating the four plotting-data objects
# ============================================================

base_dir <- paste0(
  "C:/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/",
  "DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021"
)

source_dir <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "Source_Data_Supplement"
)

dir.create(
  source_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# Supplementary Figure 6: assembly contiguity
# One row = one organism × assembler × contiguity metric
# ============================================================

suppl_figure_6 <- assembly_contiguity_data |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Organism = as.character(Organism),
    Sequencing_Technology = as.character(Technology),
    Assembler = as.character(Assembler_Plot),
    Metric = as.character(Metric),
    Value = as.numeric(Value)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(Value)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    Metric,
    Organism,
    Assembler
  )

readr::write_excel_csv(
  suppl_figure_6,
  file.path(source_dir, "Suppl_Figure_6.csv"),
  na = ""
)


# ============================================================
```
